cost_model.bare_io_floor: Z0: raw pread/pwrite (and Z1: raw liburing minimal submit/reap) — no lifecycle safety, no stale-completion protection, no exactly-once publication, no waiter, no continuation.
cost_model.semantic_floor: Z1b: minimal semantic-equivalent liburing harness providing EXACTLY the safety/lifecycle semantics the compared workload requires (bounded in-flight, stable request identity, generation/stale-completion protection, exactly-once terminal publication, safe caller buffer lifetime, one continuation, cooperative wait/resume, no per-op heap allocation if Sluice also avoids it). Removing safety semantics to make the floor look cheap is FORBIDDEN.
cost_model.capability_cost: semantic_floor - bare_floor. Necessary by definition; not a tax.
cost_model.abstraction_tax: Sluice - semantic_floor. The ONLY quantity this round is authorized to optimize.
cost_model.forbidden_measure: Sluice - raw_liburing(Z1) mislabeled as abstraction overhead: conflates capability cost with implementation cost.

seams.interpretation_guard: The question is NOT 'how many mutexes' but: (1) what invariant each acquisition protects; (2) which transitions need independent linearization points (reserve, commit, record_terminal, reap-publish, release DO; prepare/install_binding/enqueue-mark-running transitions are orderable); (3) which are historical splitting vs semantic (single centralized submit_transaction ladder is a deliberate ADR structure — acceptance LP ordering, rollback ladder); (4) disjoint-slot transitions semantically commute yet physically serialize on ONE lock; (5) Scalable Commutativity Rule applies in principle — but weakening semantic authority is forbidden and per-slot sharding touches admission transaction + Scheme-B + reap ordering (new-ADR territory).

code_fact.single_driver_answer: In single-issuer/single-worker/manual-poll topologies all locks are UNCONTENDED (same thread re-acquires); the per-op cost is then ~N uncontended lock round-trips, not contention. In multi-worker runtime topologies access_mtx_ + arena leaf become true cross-thread serialization points.
code_fact.classification: REQUIRED-SEMANTIC-SERIALIZATION (each layer guards a different authority: caller serialization/accounting vs backend admission/dispatch arbitration vs slot lifecycle). Whether the PHYSICAL stacking is redundant in single-driver regimes is a measurement question.

z1b_design.name: Minimal Semantic-Equivalent Uring harness (Z1b)
required_semantics: stable request identity (never-reused cookie or generation-tagged slot)
generation/stale-completion protection (stale CQE dropped, never misdelivered)
safe caller buffer lifetime (borrowed buffer held until that request's terminal)
one continuation per request (cooperative wait/resume — e.g. one-shot wait on the request's own completion flag/epoch)
no per-op heap allocation (matching Sluice's hot-path property)
z1b_design.forbidden: secretly deleting safety semantics to manufacture a cheaper 'floor'
z1b_design.purpose: semantic_floor for the Z2/Z3 comparison: Sluice - Z1b = the only admissible abstraction-tax measure; Z1b - Z1 = capability cost

seams.status: HYPOTHESIS (floor not yet built; purchase map is structural FACT)

ladder.Z1: raw liburing minimal submission/reap (io_uring_prep_read + io_uring_submit + io_uring_peek_cqe family; NO lifecycle semantics)
ladder.Z2: AsyncIoContext + UringAsyncBackend, manual poll/reap, NO Scheduler
ladder.Z4: representative Sluice application path (composition amplification check only)

z_ladder_preregistration.definitions: capability_cost = Z1b - Z1; abstraction_tax = Z2 (or Z3) - Z1b; Z2 - Z1 is NOT a valid tax measure
z_ladder_preregistration.non_comparable_rule: a layer that cannot provide the same semantics is marked NOT-SEMANTICALLY-COMPARABLE; no ratio is computed
z_ladder_preregistration.matrix_minimum: 4KiB d{1,8,32,64}; 64KiB d{1,8,32}; 1MiB d{1,8,32}; read+write; workers {1,4} for worker-sensitive layers; historical 4K high-depth w4 cliff cell (4KiB d>=32 w4) is a mandatory re-judgment cell; #221 WSL2/tmpfs numbers are replication targets only

Measurement sessions run in a different environment MUST re-establish: kernel, liburing, CPU topology/affinity/governor, filesystem, and tag ENVIRONMENT-LIMITED when on WSL2/VM/tmpfs/CI; pilot numbers are never universal conclusions.
z_ladder_preregistration.lifecycle_separation_rule: construction/startup, registration/setup, first-touch/page-fault, warm steady-state, shutdown/drain are SEPARATE line items; runtime startup/thread/ring creation/allocation must not be amortized into per-I/O tax, and per-op bookkeeping must not be hidden outside setup
z_ladder_preregistration.tax_stack_target: per representative cell: total cycles/op decomposed into kernel/device; io_uring submit/reap; required lifecycle/identity; cancellation capability; publication; waiter registration; routing; scheduler wake; fiber resume; accidental residual — each labeled MEASURED | INFERRED_BY_AB | STRUCTURAL_ONLY | UNKNOWN; structural counts are never presented as performance attribution

first_optimization_gate.rule: after TAX-0A2/B/C/D, rank candidates by measured cost magnitude, causal confidence, semantic risk, implementation size, cross-workload breadth, expected gain, possible regression; EXACTLY ONE production optimization authorized per round; simplicity (F01/F02 being easy) is not a selection criterion; #255 fix-selection gate applies when 2+ semantically valid fixes exist
first_optimization_gate.production_change_rules: one mechanism / one causal hypothesis / one semantic invariant / one before-after experiment; forbidden: drive-by cleanup, mass renames, arena/scheduler rewrites, lock-free rewrites, allocator frameworks, buffer changes, public API redesign, memory_order weakening
first_optimization_gate.current_recommendation: NONE — no measurement exists; ranking before TAX-0B/C/D evidence would be a story, not a verdict

do_not_optimize_yet: arena single lock (semantic arbitration domain; sharding touches admission transaction + Scheme-B + reap order; new-ADR territory)
global_mtx_ unified domain (MW classification + owner records + wake epoch + idle-dance, TLA+-verified)
submit ladder staged locking (segmented rollback semantics; merging unproven)
std::deque local_runnable (STL type is not a finding absent bounce evidence)
timer pool O(pool) recompute/scan (absent from E1-shape hot path)
F02 seq_cst-vs-relaxed comment/code divergence (recorded; fixing ordering WITHOUT measurement would itself be an unmeasured change)
